title: [E16] Architecture, security, tests, deployment & operations
body:
<!-- nasj-backlog:E16 -->

Parent epic for **Architecture, security, tests, deployment & operations**.

**Owner role:** Engineering/QA  
**Status:** Proposed  
**Stories:** 12  
**Provisional story points:** 56

All child stories preserve the detailed backlog acceptance criteria, technical deliverables and verification evidence. Estimates and assignees remain unconfirmed. Synthetic transactions and individual wearable data remain separate from live commerce.

- [ ] [E16-01 — Pure Domain State, Money and Quantity Invariants](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/32)

- [ ] [E16-06 — Idempotent Commands and Replay-Safe Mutations](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/75)
- [ ] [E16-07 — Transactional Audit and Reliable Outbox Events](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/76)
- [ ] [E16-08 — Backups, Restore Drills and Operational Observability](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/77)

- [ ] [E16-10 — Observable Background Jobs and Analytics ETL](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/196)
- [ ] [E16-11 — Reproducible TypeScript Monorepo and Database Foundation](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/30)
- [ ] [E16-12 — Firmware, Local Summary and Privacy Test Matrix](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/197)

### Epic completion criteria

- [ ] Every child story has acceptance evidence and review.
- [ ] Relevant release gates, permissions and domain invariants are verified.
- [ ] Synthetic, observed and verified results are clearly identified.
